generic.Defined scope/population: All artefacts of the reported capital model release: parameters, correlation matrix, run log, results and sign-off memo
generic.In-scope period: The valuation quarter whose internal capital model release is being archived
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Archive header carries model version tag, run date, random seed, executor and results extract location
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived results extract agrees to the reported coverage ratio and capital requirement figure for figure
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Repository entry holds every artefact with upload timestamp and an immutable version tag
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or superseded artefacts logged on the release record with owner and resolution date
generic.Test population: Every internal capital model release archived in the current reporting year
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires version tag, inputs, run log, change-log link and sign-off memo all present
generic.Exception handling path: An incomplete archive blocks release and returns to the Capital Model Actuary for completion
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Release record states the artefact list required before an archive is marked complete
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository release record for the archived model version

steps.title: Open the release record in the model governance repository
sop: Create or open the release record for the reported model version in the model governance repository
Copy the model version tag, run date and random seed from the actuarial modeling platform run register
List the artefacts required by the archive policy against that release
Done when the release record exists and names the exact model version being archived
verify: Confirm the version tag on the record matches the version that produced the reported results
Pass when the record carries version tag, run date and seed for the reported run

steps.title: Export parameter file and correlation matrix from the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Export the production parameter file and correlation matrix used by the locked model version
Export the calibration workbook that supports those parameters
Upload all three to the same model governance repository release entry
Done when parameters, matrix and calibration workbook are attached to the release entry
verify: Reopen each uploaded file and check it opens and carries the same version tag
Pass when all three inputs are attached and readable under the correct release

steps.title: Attach the run log and convergence diagnostics to the release entry
sop: Export the run log and convergence diagnostics for the archived run from the modeling platform
Check the log for warnings or failed sub-model calls before upload
Attach the log and diagnostics alongside the results extract in the repository
Done when run log, diagnostics and results extract sit under one release entry
verify: Compare the run id in the log against the run id on the results extract
Pass when both carry the same run id and the log shows no unresolved failure

steps.title: Link the prior-version diff and change-log entry in the repository
sop: Generate the diff between this model version and the previously archived version
Create or locate the change-log entry describing each change made
Link the diff and change-log entry to the release record
Done when the release record links a diff and a change-log entry
verify: Check every change shown in the diff appears in the linked change-log entry
Pass when no diffed change is missing from the change log

steps.title: File the Chief Actuary and CRO sign-off memo on the release record
sop: Confirm the sign-off memo names the model version, run id and valuation date being approved
Upload the signed memo to the model governance repository release record
Record signature names and dates in the release metadata
Done when the signed memo is filed against the release record
verify: Check the memo version and run id match the archived artefacts
Pass when a dual-signed memo is filed against the correct model version

steps.title: Lock the release entry as immutable in the model governance repository
sop: Run the archive completeness check against the artefact list on the record
Resolve or log any missing artefact with an owner and resolution date
Set the repository entry to immutable and record the retention expiry
Done when the release entry is locked and marked complete
verify: Attempt an edit on the locked entry to confirm immutability is enforced
Pass when the entry is immutable, complete and carries a retention date

generic.Defined scope/population: Every quantitative risk appetite limit that applies to the modelled economic capital position
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting quarter using the signed capital model run for that quarter
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each limit row carries the limit value, the actual value, the RAG status and the headroom
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actual values in the assessment tie back to the signed capital run and available capital figures
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Appetite assessment memo saved with the run id, assessment date and version in the repository
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every limit breach logged in the GRC risk register with owner and remediation date
generic.Test population: All quantitative appetite limits in force for the assessed quarter
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a RAG status and headroom figure against every limit with no limit untested
generic.Exception handling path: Amber or red status escalates to the Chief Actuary and is logged with a remediation plan
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Risk appetite statement defines each limit, its amber and red thresholds and the measurement basis
generic.Evidence location: Signed appetite assessment memo in the model governance repository plus GRC risk register entries

steps.title: Extract the in-force appetite limits from the GRC platform
sop: Pull the current risk appetite statement limits from the GRC platform
Record each limit metric, its threshold value and its amber and red trigger levels
Confirm with the Chief Actuary that no limit changed since the last assessment
Done when a complete limit list for the quarter is captured
verify: Cross-check the limit list against the board-approved appetite statement
Pass when every quantitative limit in the statement appears on the list

steps.title: Pull modelled economic capital results from the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Open the signed capital model run for the assessed quarter in the modeling platform
Export solvency ratio, value at risk and earnings-at-risk measures needed by the limits
Record the run id against the extract
Done when every metric needed by a limit has an actual value from the signed run
verify: Trace two exported metrics back to the modelling platform output for the same run id
Pass when all actual values come from one signed run

steps.title: Compare each actual against its limit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Build the comparison sheet with limit, actual, variance and headroom columns in Excel
Compute headroom in both currency and ratio points for each limit
Apply the amber and red rules to assign a RAG status per risk category
Done when every limit row shows variance, headroom and a RAG status
verify: Recompute headroom for the tightest limit by hand
Pass when the manual recomputation matches the sheet and no row lacks a status

steps.title: Log breaches in the GRC risk register
sop: Raise a register entry in the GRC platform for each amber or red limit
Record the breach amount, cause, accountable owner and remediation date
Link the entry to the appetite assessment for the quarter
Done when every amber or red limit has a register entry
verify: Reconcile the count of amber and red rows to the count of register entries raised
Pass when the two counts agree with no unlogged breach

steps.title: Draft the appetite assessment memo for Chief Actuary review
sop: Summarise RAG status by risk category and state headroom to the internal capital target
Explain each breach and the remediation committed to
Attach the comparison sheet and the run id used
Done when the draft memo covers every limit and breach
verify: Check each figure in the memo against the Excel comparison sheet
Pass when memo figures and sheet figures agree exactly

steps.title: Obtain Chief Actuary signature before ORSA inclusion
sop: Review the assessment against the appetite statement and challenge any status call
Record any change directed and have the memo reissued
Sign and date the memo and file it in the model governance repository
Done when the signed memo is filed for the quarter
verify: Confirm the filed memo carries a signature, a date and the source run id
Pass when a signed current-quarter memo exists before the ORSA is issued

generic.Defined scope/population: All modelled risk modules and all legal entities and business units inside the capital model boundary
generic.In-scope period: The valuation quarter of the signed capital model run being attributed
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each attribution row carries risk module, business unit, standalone capital and allocated diversified capital
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Allocated capital by entity and by business unit sums to the group diversified total within tolerance
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Attribution workbook saved with run id, allocation basis and production date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Residual differences above tolerance logged with cause and correction before publication
generic.Test population: Every risk module and business unit in the attribution output for the quarter
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the sum of allocated capital ties to the diversified group total inside the stated tolerance
generic.Exception handling path: An out-of-tolerance residual stops publication and returns to the Capital Model Actuary for rework
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Allocation methodology note states the Euler or Shapley basis and the reconciliation tolerance
generic.Evidence location: Attribution workbook and modelling platform allocation output for the run id

steps.title: Extract standalone capital by risk module from the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Open the signed capital run in the modeling platform for the valuation quarter
Export standalone capital for underwriting, reserve, market, credit and operational modules
Record the run id and export timestamp against the extract
Done when standalone capital exists for every modelled risk module
verify: Check no risk module in the model boundary is missing from the export
Pass when every module in scope carries a standalone figure

steps.title: Apply the documented diversification allocation basis in the modeling platform
sop: Confirm the allocation basis in force is the documented Euler or Shapley method
Run the allocation routine to spread the diversification benefit across modules
State the basis used on the output header
Done when diversification benefit is allocated and the basis is stated on the output
verify: Check the allocated benefit sums to the total diversification benefit from the run
Pass when the allocated benefit reconciles to the run total

steps.title: Split allocated capital by legal entity and business unit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the allocation output into the attribution workbook in Excel
Map each modelled segment to its legal entity and business unit
Pivot allocated capital by both risk category and business unit
Done when the pivot shows allocated capital on both axes
verify: Check every modelled segment maps to exactly one entity and one business unit
Pass when no segment is unmapped or double counted

steps.title: Reconcile allocated totals to the group diversified requirement
sop: Sum allocated capital across entities and compare to the group diversified total
Sum across business units and repeat the comparison
Record the residual and test it against the documented tolerance
Done when both sums are compared and the residual is recorded
verify: Recompute one of the two sums independently in Excel
Pass when both sums tie to the group total inside tolerance

steps.title: Explain movement in allocated capital versus the prior period
sop: Load the prior period attribution and compute the change per business unit
Attribute each material movement to volume, mix, experience or method change
Write the explanation into the attribution workbook commentary tab
Done when every material movement carries an explanation
verify: Check the sum of explained drivers equals the total movement per unit
Pass when driver explanations foot to the total movement

steps.title: Publish the attribution exhibit and archive the workbook
sop: Produce the single exhibit showing attribution by risk category and by business unit
Tag the workbook with run id, allocation basis and production date
Save the final workbook to the agreed capital reporting location
Done when the tagged exhibit is published for the quarter
verify: Open the published exhibit and confirm both attribution axes appear together
Pass when the published exhibit is tagged and shows both splits

generic.Defined scope/population: All balance sheet items feeding economic own funds for each in-scope legal entity
generic.In-scope period: The valuation date of the closed trial balance used for the capital cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each walk line carries the ledger source, the adjustment amount, the sign and the supporting schedule
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Opening statutory equity on the walk agrees to the closed trial balance for the valuation date
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Available capital walk saved with valuation date, ledger extract date and preparer name
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unexplained reconciling items above materiality logged with owner and resolution before sign-off
generic.Test population: Every adjustment line on the statutory equity to economic own funds walk
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no unexplained reconciling item exceeds the documented materiality threshold
generic.Exception handling path: Items above materiality are referred to the Valuation Actuary and Finance before the walk is finalised
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Own funds methodology note defines each permitted adjustment and the materiality threshold
generic.Evidence location: Available capital walk workbook with linked ledger extract and investment schedule

steps.title: Extract closed trial balance equity from the ERP general ledger
sop: Confirm the period is closed in the ERP general ledger for the valuation date
Extract statutory or GAAP equity by legal entity with account level detail
Save the extract with the query and run timestamp
Done when equity is extracted for every in-scope entity from a closed period
verify: Compare extracted equity to the reported balance sheet equity for the same date
Pass when extracted equity equals the reported figure for each entity

steps.title: Apply market value adjustments to invested assets in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the investment schedule and compare carrying value to market value by holding
Compute the market value adjustment by asset class in Excel
Reconcile the total adjustment to the investment schedule totals
Done when the market value adjustment is computed and reconciled
verify: Recompute the adjustment for the largest asset class independently
Pass when the recomputation matches and the total ties to the investment schedule

steps.title: Replace technical provisions with best estimate plus risk margin
sop: Take best estimate liabilities and risk margin from the actuarial modeling platform for the valuation date
Compute the difference against the booked technical provisions by line
Enter the replacement as a discrete line on the walk
Done when technical provisions are replaced on an economic basis
verify: Trace the best estimate and risk margin to the signed valuation run
Pass when both components come from the signed run for the same date

steps.title: Remove non-admitted assets, DTA limitation and intangibles
sop: List non-admitted assets and intangibles from the ledger extract
Apply the deferred tax asset limitation on the prescribed basis
Deduct each item on its own line with a supporting reference
Done when every prescribed deduction is applied and referenced
verify: Check each deduction line carries a schedule or ledger reference
Pass when no deduction is unsupported

steps.title: Build the line-by-line available capital walk
sop: Assemble the walk from statutory equity to economic own funds in Excel
Show each adjustment on its own line with sign and source
Compute the closing economic available capital figure
Done when the walk runs end to end with a closing own funds figure
verify: Foot the walk and compare the closing figure to the modelling platform own funds input
Pass when the walk foots and matches the platform input

steps.title: Clear residuals and load available capital to the modeling platform
sop: Test every reconciling item against the documented materiality threshold
Resolve or log items above threshold with owner and disposition
Load the agreed available capital figure into the actuarial modeling platform
Done when residuals are cleared and available capital is loaded
verify: Check the loaded platform figure against the walk closing balance
Pass when the loaded figure equals the walk closing balance with no open material residual

generic.Defined scope/population: Every risk module parameter in the internal capital model covering underwriting, market, credit and operational risk
generic.In-scope period: The data period used for the calibration cycle stated per module
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each parameter row carries distribution family, fitted values, data period, fit statistic and owner
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Fitted parameter set loaded to the platform matches the approved calibration workbook value for value
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calibration workbook versioned in the model governance repository with the peer review record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every expert judgement override logged in the parameter register with rationale and expiry
generic.Test population: All risk module parameters recalibrated in the current cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when each parameter has a stated basis, data period and peer review sign-off
generic.Exception handling path: Parameters failing goodness-of-fit go to the Chief Actuary for a judgement decision before loading
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Calibration standard sets the confidence level, fit tests and evidence needed per module
generic.Evidence location: Calibration workbook and parameter register in the model governance repository

steps.title: Assemble calibration datasets from the data warehouse
sop: Pull loss, premium, market and credit history from the data warehouse for the agreed data period
Check each series for gaps, outliers and changes in basis
Record the data period and any exclusions on the dataset header
Done when a documented dataset exists for every module being calibrated
verify: Reconcile dataset totals to the source system for one year of history
Pass when totals agree and the data period is documented

steps.title: Fit distributions for underwriting and reserve risk in Microsoft Excel
sop: Fit the candidate distribution families to each underwriting and reserve series
Record fitted parameters and goodness-of-fit statistics for each candidate
Select the preferred family and note why alternatives were rejected
Done when a selected family and fitted parameters exist per module
verify: Check the fit statistic for the selected family against the rejected alternatives
Pass when the selection is supported by the recorded fit statistics

steps.title: Calibrate market and credit shocks to the 99.5 percent one-year level
sop: Derive market and credit shocks at the stated one-in-two-hundred confidence level
State the historical window and any stress period weighting used
Document the derivation in the calibration workbook
Done when market and credit shocks are calibrated to the stated confidence level
verify: Recompute one shock from the underlying series
Pass when the recomputed shock matches and the confidence level is stated

steps.title: Set the operational risk parameter basis with workshop evidence
sop: Confirm whether the operational basis is scenario based or factor based for this cycle
Attach the scenario workshop notes and participant list as evidence
Record the resulting parameters in the calibration workbook
Done when the operational basis is documented with supporting evidence
verify: Check the workshop evidence supports each operational scenario parameter
Pass when every operational parameter traces to workshop or factor evidence

steps.title: Log expert judgement overrides in the parameter register
sop: Identify every parameter set by judgement rather than by fitted data
Record owner, rationale and expiry date in the parameter register
Flag overrides that expire before the next calibration cycle
Done when every judgement override is registered with an expiry
verify: Compare the register entries to the parameters marked as judgement in the workbook
Pass when every judgement parameter has a register entry

steps.title: Load approved parameters into the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Obtain Chief Actuary peer review sign-off on the calibration workbook
Load the approved parameter file into the modeling platform under a new version tag
Run a smoke test to confirm the platform reads the parameters as intended
Done when approved parameters are loaded under a tagged version
verify: Compare the loaded platform parameters against the approved workbook value by value
Pass when every loaded value matches the signed-off workbook

generic.Defined scope/population: Exposure, premium, reserve, asset, reinsurance and counterparty extracts feeding the capital model run
generic.In-scope period: All extracts pulled as at the same valuation date for the capital cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each extract carries entity, line of business, accident year and exposure keys with no blanks
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extract control totals reconcile to the ledger and to the reserving triangles before load
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Input validation memo saved with extract names, run dates and control totals
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Data quality exceptions logged as corrected, accepted or excluded before the run starts
generic.Test population: Every input extract loaded into the capital model run
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every extract passes completeness and reconciliation checks with no blocking exception
generic.Exception handling path: Failed extracts are returned to the Data Analyst and reloaded before the model run is released
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Input standard defines the required fields, tolerances and checks per extract
generic.Evidence location: Signed input validation memo attached to the run record with the extract queries

steps.title: Pull exposure and premium extracts from the data warehouse
sop: Run the agreed exposure and premium queries in the data warehouse at the valuation date
Save the query text, parameters and run timestamp with the output
Record row counts and monetary totals for each extract
Done when exposure and premium extracts exist with saved queries and totals
verify: Compare extract premium totals to the ledger written premium for the period
Pass when premium totals agree inside the documented tolerance

steps.title: Pull reserve, asset and counterparty extracts from the enterprise lakehouse
sop: Extract reserve balances, asset holdings and reinsurance counterparty balances at the same valuation date
Confirm every extract uses the same as-at date and currency basis
Record row counts and totals for each extract
Done when all remaining extracts are pulled at the common valuation date
verify: Check the as-at date on each extract header
Pass when every extract carries the same valuation date

steps.title: Reconcile control totals to the ledger and reserving triangles
sop: Compare reserve extract totals to the reserving triangles by line and accident year
Compare asset and premium totals to the general ledger balances
Record each difference with its cause
Done when every extract total is compared and differences are recorded
verify: Recompute one reconciliation line independently
Pass when all differences sit inside tolerance or carry a recorded cause

steps.title: Run completeness checks for missing years, blank keys and negative reserves
sop: Test each extract for missing accident years and blank exposure keys
Flag negative reserves and zero exposure records for review
List every failed record with its identifier
Done when completeness checks are run across all extracts
verify: Re-run the checks after correction and compare failure counts
Pass when no unexplained completeness failure remains

steps.title: Log data quality exceptions with disposition
sop: Record each exception with extract name, record count and monetary effect
Assign a disposition of corrected, accepted or excluded with a reason
Escalate exceptions material to capital to the Capital Model Actuary
Done when every exception carries a disposition
verify: Reconcile the exception log count to the failed record count
Pass when every failed record maps to a logged disposition

steps.title: Issue the signed input validation memo and release extracts to the model
sop: Write the memo covering extracts used, control totals, exceptions and known limitations
Obtain Capital Model Actuary sign-off on the memo
Release the validated extracts to the actuarial modeling platform input area
Done when the signed memo is filed and extracts are released
verify: Check the extracts loaded to the platform match those named in the memo
Pass when only memo-listed extracts are present in the model input area

generic.Defined scope/population: Available economic capital and the 99.5 percent one-year economic capital requirement for the reporting entity
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter of the signed capital model run used for the ratio
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Ratio record carries numerator, denominator, run id, basis and calculation date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Numerator and denominator agree to the signed available capital walk and the model run output
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Ratio calculation saved with run id and version and copied to the capital dashboard
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unexplained movement drivers logged and cleared before the ratio is published
generic.Test population: Each reported coverage ratio produced in the quarter on diversified and undiversified bases
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the ratio reconciles to source inputs and the driver split foots to the total movement
generic.Exception handling path: A ratio failing reconciliation is withheld from the dashboard until the difference is explained
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Capital reporting standard defines the ratio formula, bases and target comparison
generic.Evidence location: Ratio workbook and the capital dashboard entry carrying the source run id

steps.title: Retrieve the capital requirement from the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Open the signed capital run for the quarter in the modeling platform
Export the diversified and undiversified capital requirement at the 99.5 percent level
Record the run id against both figures
Done when both requirement figures are exported with the run id
verify: Check the exported requirement against the run summary output
Pass when both figures agree to the run summary for the same run id

steps.title: Retrieve available economic capital from the signed capital walk
sop: Open the signed available capital walk for the same valuation date
Take the closing economic own funds figure as the numerator
Confirm the valuation date matches the model run
Done when the numerator is taken from the signed walk for the matching date
verify: Compare the numerator to the walk closing balance
Pass when the numerator equals the signed walk closing balance

steps.title: Compute the coverage ratio on both bases in Microsoft Excel
sop: Divide available economic capital by the diversified requirement in the ratio workbook
Repeat using the undiversified requirement
Show both ratios with the run id and calculation date
Done when both ratios are computed and labelled
verify: Recompute one ratio by hand from the source figures
Pass when the manual result matches the workbook to the reported precision

steps.title: Compare the ratio against target and trigger levels
sop: Load the internal capital target and the amber and red trigger levels
Compute headroom to target in ratio points and in currency
Flag the ratio where it sits below any trigger
Done when the ratio is compared to target and all triggers
verify: Check the trigger levels used against the approved capital policy
Pass when the comparison uses the current approved trigger levels

steps.title: Split the quarter-on-quarter movement by driver
sop: Compute the change in the ratio since the prior quarter
Attribute the change to new business, experience, assumption and market drivers
Show the driver split alongside the ratio
Done when the movement is fully attributed to drivers
verify: Sum the driver amounts and compare to the total ratio movement
Pass when drivers foot to the total movement with no unexplained residual

steps.title: Publish the ratio and drivers to the capital dashboard
sop: Copy the ratio, target comparison and driver split into the capital dashboard
Tag the dashboard entry with the source run id and calculation date
Notify the reporting distribution list that the quarter is published
Done when the dashboard shows the ratio with its run id
verify: Compare the dashboard figures against the ratio workbook
Pass when dashboard and workbook agree and the run id is shown

generic.Defined scope/population: Every pairwise dependency between modelled risk modules in the internal capital model
generic.In-scope period: The calibration cycle for which the correlation matrix will be in force
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each off-diagonal cell carries a value, a source tag of empirical, benchmark or judgement, and an owner
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matrix dimensions match the modelled module list with no missing or surplus cells
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Matrix versioned in the model governance repository with the eigenvalue check evidence attached
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cells failing the positive semi-definite check logged with the adjustment applied and its rationale
generic.Test population: All cells of the correlation matrix adopted for the cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the matrix is positive semi-definite and every cell carries a source tag
generic.Exception handling path: A non positive semi-definite matrix is repaired and re-tested before the Chief Actuary reviews it
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dependency methodology note states the copula choice, evidence hierarchy and adjustment rules
generic.Evidence location: Versioned matrix file and eigenvalue check evidence in the model governance repository

steps.title: Confirm the module list and matrix dimensions in the modeling platform
sop: List the modelled risk modules in the actuarial modeling platform for the cycle
Set the matrix dimensions to match that module list exactly
Carry forward prior-year values as the starting point
Done when the matrix shell matches the current module list
verify: Compare matrix row and column labels against the platform module list
Pass when labels match with no missing or surplus module

steps.title: Populate cells and tag each source in Microsoft Excel
sop: Set each off-diagonal cell from empirical analysis, benchmark study or expert judgement
Tag every cell with its source type and the reference document
Record the owner for each judgement cell
Done when every off-diagonal cell carries a value and a source tag
verify: Scan the tag column for blanks or default values
Pass when no cell is untagged or left at a placeholder value

steps.title: Run the positive semi-definite eigenvalue check
sop: Compute the eigenvalues of the populated matrix in Excel
Confirm no eigenvalue is negative and record the smallest value
Apply the documented repair method if the check fails and re-run it
Done when the matrix passes the eigenvalue check and evidence is saved
verify: Re-run the eigenvalue computation on the final matrix
Pass when the smallest eigenvalue is not negative

steps.title: Document the tail dependency and copula treatment
sop: State the copula family and tail parameter used in the modeling platform
Justify the choice against the dependency methodology note
Attach the justification to the matrix release entry
Done when the copula choice and tail parameter are documented
verify: Check the platform copula setting against the documented choice
Pass when the platform setting matches the documented treatment

steps.title: Quantify sensitivity of diversified capital to correlation shifts
sop: Shift each key correlation by plus and minus zero point one in turn
Re-run diversified capital in the modeling platform for each shift
Tabulate the capital impact per shifted cell
Done when sensitivity results exist for every key correlation
verify: Check that the sensitivity table covers each cell flagged as key
Pass when no key correlation lacks a quantified sensitivity

steps.title: Version the matrix in the model governance repository with change rationale
sop: Compare the matrix cell by cell against the prior year version
Review the rationale recorded for each changed cell
Approve and version tag the matrix in the model governance repository
Done when the approved matrix is versioned with a cell-level change log
verify: Check every changed cell in the diff carries a rationale
Pass when no changed cell is missing its rationale

generic.Defined scope/population: All legal entities, business units and risk categories considered for inclusion in the internal capital model
generic.In-scope period: The modelling cycle the scope document governs stated with its effective date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Scope document states entities, risk categories, time horizon, confidence level and materiality threshold
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: In-scope plus out-of-scope entities equal the full legal entity register with none unaccounted
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved scope document versioned in the model governance repository with committee minutes referenced
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risks and entities excluded on materiality logged with the justification and review date
generic.Test population: Every entity and risk category assessed for inclusion in the cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when horizon, confidence level and materiality threshold are stated and every exclusion is justified
generic.Exception handling path: Unjustified exclusions are returned to the Capital Model Actuary before committee submission
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Model governance policy defines what a scope document must state and who approves it
generic.Evidence location: Approved scope document in the model governance repository plus the GRC risk inventory mapping

steps.title: List candidate entities from the legal entity register
sop: Pull the current legal entity and business unit register
Mark each entity as inside or outside the intended model boundary
Note the reason for every exclusion
Done when every registered entity carries an in or out decision
verify: Count in-scope plus out-of-scope entities against the register total
Pass when the counts agree with none unassigned

steps.title: Map risk categories to the enterprise risk inventory in the GRC platform
sop: Open the enterprise risk inventory in the GRC platform
Map each inventory risk to a model risk category or mark it out of scope
Record the justification for every out-of-scope risk
Done when every inventory risk is mapped or justified as excluded
verify: Check for inventory risks with no mapping and no justification
Pass when no risk is left unmapped and unjustified

steps.title: State the modelling horizon and confidence level
sop: Set the modelled time horizon at one year in the scope document
State the confidence level as 99.5 percent value at risk
Confirm consistency with the regulatory basis the group reports under
Done when horizon and confidence level are stated in the document
verify: Compare the stated basis against the regulatory and policy requirements
Pass when horizon and confidence level match the required basis

steps.title: Define and apply the materiality threshold
sop: Set the materiality threshold for including a risk or entity
Apply the threshold to the entity and risk lists and record the outcome
Log borderline cases with the decision taken
Done when the threshold is defined and applied across both lists
verify: Re-test two borderline items against the stated threshold
Pass when the recorded decisions follow the stated threshold

steps.title: Draft the scope document in the model governance repository
sop: Assemble entities, risk categories, horizon, confidence level and threshold into the scope document
Attach the exclusion justifications as an annex
Version the draft in the model governance repository
Done when a complete versioned draft exists for committee review
verify: Check each required section is present in the draft
Pass when no required section is missing

steps.title: Obtain Model Governance Committee approval and record minutes
sop: Table the scope document at the Model Governance Committee
Capture challenge and any directed scope change
Record approval and the minute reference on the document
Done when the document shows committee approval and a minute reference
verify: Open the approved document and check for the approval date and minute reference
Pass when both are recorded on the approved version

generic.Defined scope/population: The internal capital position for the named model version and run id being approved
generic.In-scope period: The valuation date of the capital results submitted for sign-off
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Sign-off memo states model version, run id, valuation date, signatories and any qualification
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Figures in the memo agree to the archived model run output for the stated run id

steps.title: Prepare the sign-off memo naming version, run id and valuation date

Insert the headline capital requirement, available capital and coverage ratio
Attach the archived run output as the supporting reference

verify: Check the memo figures against the archived run output

steps.title: Disclose open validation findings in the memo

List each finding with severity, owner and remediation date in the memo
State the effect of each finding on the reported result

steps.title: Route the memo for Chief Actuary review in the model governance repository

Record review comments on the repository record

steps.title: Route the memo for Chief Risk Officer signature via the GRC platform

Record the approval decision and date in the platform

steps.title: Write any qualification or limitation into the memo

File the signed memo in the model governance repository release record
Release the approved results to the reporting distribution only after filing

generic.Defined scope/population: All actuarial sections of the ICAAP or ORSA covering solvency needs, projections and stress results

steps.title: State overall solvency needs on economic and regulatory bases

Take the regulatory requirement from the current regulatory capital calculation
Present both bases side by side with the same valuation date
Done when solvency needs are stated on both bases
verify: Trace each figure to its source run or filing workbook
Pass when both bases tie to their source calculation

steps.title: Build the forward capital projection over the business plan
sop: Project available and required capital for each year of the three-year plan
Use the approved plan volumes, mix and investment assumptions without adjustment
Chart the projected coverage ratio path against the internal target
Done when a year-by-year projection exists over the plan horizon
verify: Compare the plan inputs used against the approved plan file
Pass when projection inputs match the approved plan

steps.title: Incorporate stress and reverse-stress results with management actions
sop: Insert the approved stress and reverse-stress results into the assessment
Show the post-action position alongside the pre-action position
Cross-reference the scenario definitions used
Done when stress results and management actions are embedded
verify: Check each stress figure against the stress output file
Pass when embedded results equal the source stress output

steps.title: Explain differences between the internal model and the regulatory formula
sop: Compare the requirement by risk module on both bases in Excel
Quantify each material difference and state its cause
Present the bridge from regulatory to economic requirement
Done when the bridge explains every material difference
verify: Foot the bridge from regulatory to economic requirement
Pass when the bridge foots with no unexplained residual

steps.title: Draft the continuous compliance conclusion
sop: State explicitly whether the entity expects to meet capital requirements throughout the horizon
Reference the projection and stress evidence supporting the conclusion
Disclose any period where compliance depends on a management action
Done when the compliance conclusion is stated with its evidence
verify: Check the conclusion is consistent with the projection and stress exhibits
Pass when no exhibit contradicts the stated conclusion

steps.title: Version the assessment in the model governance repository
sop: Assemble narrative and exhibits into the assessment document
Reconcile every figure in the text back to its source exhibit
Version the document in the model governance repository ahead of the deadline
Done when the reconciled assessment is versioned in the repository
verify: Sample five narrative figures and trace them to the exhibits
Pass when all sampled figures agree with the exhibits

generic.Defined scope/population: All valuation and accounting differences between statutory surplus and economic surplus for the entity

steps.title: Extract statutory surplus from the ERP general ledger

Save the extract with its query and timestamp
Set the extract figure as the bridge opening balance
Done when the bridge opens from the closed ledger surplus
verify: Compare the opening balance to the filed statutory surplus
Pass when the opening balance equals the filed figure

steps.title: Quantify asset valuation differences in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compare amortised cost carrying values to market values by asset class
Compute the difference and enter it as a discrete bridge line
Attach the investment schedule supporting the amount
Done when asset valuation differences sit on their own bridge line
verify: Recompute the difference for the largest asset class
Pass when the recomputation matches the bridge line

steps.title: Quantify liability valuation differences from the modeling platform
sop: Take best estimate liabilities and risk margin from the actuarial modeling platform
Compare against statutory reserves by line of business
Enter the difference as a separate bridge line with the source run id
Done when liability differences sit on their own bridge line
verify: Trace the best estimate and risk margin to the signed valuation run
Pass when both components come from the signed run

steps.title: Apply the deferred tax effect and agree it with Finance
sop: Compute the deferred tax effect of each adjustment at the applicable rate
Show the tax effect on the same line as the gross adjustment
Agree the treatment with Finance and record the confirmation
Done when every adjustment shows its deferred tax effect
verify: Check every gross adjustment line carries a tax line
Pass when no adjustment lacks a tax effect or an explicit nil

steps.title: Foot the bridge and test the residual against tolerance
sop: Foot the bridge and compare the closing balance to the economic surplus figure
Express the residual as a percentage of surplus
Investigate and clear residuals above the documented tolerance
Done when the residual is quantified and within tolerance
verify: Recompute the residual percentage independently
Pass when the residual sits below the documented tolerance

steps.title: Sign and file the reconciliation with supporting links
sop: Attach the ledger extract, investment schedule and valuation output to the workbook
Obtain reviewer initials on every adjustment line
Save the signed bridge with version and valuation date
Done when the signed bridge is filed with all supporting links
verify: Open each attached support file from the workbook link
Pass when every bridge line has a working supporting link and reviewer initial

generic.Defined scope/population: Capital model results reported to the Board Risk and Capital Committee for the group and key entities

steps.title: Assemble headline capital figures in Microsoft Excel

steps.title: Summarise movement drivers on a single page

Pass when the drivers foot to the total movement

steps.title: Present appetite RAG status and breaches with proposed actions
sop: Insert the quarter appetite assessment RAG table into the pack

steps.title: Disclose model limitations and open validation findings
sop: Pull open findings and known model limitations from the findings register

Insert the disclosure section into the pack

verify: Compare the disclosure against the open findings register

steps.title: Issue the pack to the committee before the papers deadline
sop: Finalise the pack and version it in the model governance repository
Distribute to the committee distribution list ahead of the papers deadline
Record the distribution date and recipient list
Done when the pack is distributed and the date is recorded
verify: Compare the distribution timestamp with the papers deadline
Pass when distribution occurred on or before the deadline

steps.title: Record committee decisions and actions in the minutes
sop: Capture director challenge and the responses given during the meeting
Record every decision and action with a named owner and due date
File the minutes alongside the pack in the repository
Done when decisions and actions are minuted with owners
verify: Check each action in the minutes carries an owner and a due date
Pass when no action is recorded without an owner

generic.Defined scope/population: All risk module parameters and correlation assumptions subject to the annual calibration review
generic.In-scope period: The review year including the additional year of experience added to the data period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each module row carries incumbent parameter, refitted parameter, difference and decision
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reviewed module count equals the module list in the approved model scope document

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Material refit differences retained without change are logged with an explicit rationale

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every module has a refit comparison, a backtest result and a recorded decision
generic.Exception handling path: Modules failing backtest are escalated to the Chief Actuary for a recalibration decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Calibration standard sets the annual review requirement and the materiality trigger for change
generic.Evidence location: Annual calibration review pack and parameter change log in the model governance repository

steps.title: Refit each module with the additional year of experience

Refit each risk module parameter on the extended dataset
Record refitted values beside the incumbent values in Excel
Done when every module has a refitted value against its incumbent
verify: Check the data period used matches the extended window for every module
Pass when all refits use the same extended data period

steps.title: Flag material differences between refit and incumbent
sop: Compute the difference between refitted and incumbent parameters
Apply the materiality trigger from the calibration standard
Flag every module breaching the trigger for decision
Done when material differences are flagged against the trigger
verify: Re-test two flagged and two unflagged modules against the trigger
Pass when the flagging follows the stated trigger

steps.title: Re-test correlation assumptions against updated evidence
sop: Refresh empirical and benchmark evidence for the key correlation cells
Compare the refreshed evidence to the in-force matrix values
Record where evidence no longer supports the in-force value
Done when correlations are re-tested against refreshed evidence
verify: Check each key correlation cell has a refreshed evidence reference
Pass when no key cell relies solely on superseded evidence

steps.title: Backtest the prior-year modelled distribution against actual outcomes
sop: Take the prior-year modelled distribution from the archived run
Locate the actual outcome within that distribution by percentile
Record the backtest result and any persistent bias
Done when backtest results exist for the modelled distributions
verify: Repeat the percentile placement for one module using the archived output
Pass when the recomputed percentile matches the recorded result

steps.title: Decide retain or recalibrate for each flagged module
sop: Review each flagged module with its refit, backtest and evidence
Decide to recalibrate or retain with an explicit rationale
Record the decision and effective run date
Done when every flagged module carries a decision and rationale
verify: Check each retained module has a written retention rationale
Pass when no material difference is retained without rationale

steps.title: Record decisions in the parameter change log
sop: Enter each recalibration decision in the parameter change log
State the effective run date and approver for every entry
Version the review pack in the model governance repository
Done when the change log and review pack are filed for the year
verify: Reconcile change log entries to the decisions recorded in the review pack
Pass when every decision has a matching change log entry

generic.Defined scope/population: The production capital model run covering all in-scope entities and risk modules for the cycle
generic.In-scope period: The valuation date of the validated input set used for the run

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Warnings and failed sub-model calls logged with disposition before results are accepted

generic.Exception handling path: A run with unresolved errors is discarded and re-executed rather than partially used
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Run standard sets the locked version rule, seed, simulation count and convergence tolerance
generic.Evidence location: Run register entry and the run log stored with the output extract

steps.title: Confirm the locked model version in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Check the platform shows the production model version as locked
Confirm no development change is present in the deployed version
Record the version tag in the run register entry
Done when the locked production version is confirmed and recorded
verify: Compare the deployed version tag against the approved release record
Pass when the deployed version equals the approved release

steps.title: Load the validated input set into the modeling platform
sop: Load only extracts named in the signed input validation memo from the data warehouse
Compare loaded record counts against the extract counts
Reject and reload any extract with a count mismatch
Done when all validated extracts are loaded with matching counts
verify: Check the platform load report against the extract control totals
Pass when every loaded extract matches its control total

steps.title: Set simulation count and random seed to production settings
sop: Set the simulation count to the documented production value
Set the random seed to the documented value for reproducibility
Record both settings in the run register entry
Done when count and seed match the documented production settings
verify: Compare the platform run settings against the run standard
Pass when both settings equal the documented values

steps.title: Execute the run and monitor for failures
sop: Launch the run and record the start timestamp and executor name
Monitor the run log for warnings and failed sub-model calls
Stop and investigate on any hard failure rather than continuing
Done when the run completes and the log is captured
verify: Read the run log end to end for unresolved errors
Pass when the log shows no unresolved failure

steps.title: Review convergence diagnostics at the 99.5 percentile
sop: Export convergence diagnostics for the tail percentile from the platform
Compare the Monte Carlo error against the documented tolerance
Re-run with a higher simulation count if the tolerance is breached
Done when tail convergence sits within tolerance
verify: Recompute the tail error from the diagnostics output
Pass when the error is inside the documented tolerance

steps.title: Record the run in the run register and publish the output location
sop: Enter run id, timestamp, executor, version, seed and simulation count in the run register
Store the output extract and run log at the registered location
Notify the Capital Model Actuary that results are available
Done when the register entry is complete and outputs are stored
verify: Open the registered output path and confirm extract and log are present
Pass when the register entry resolves to a complete output set

generic.Defined scope/population: All portfolio changes affecting model segmentation, reinsurance structure or asset mapping in the cycle

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Changes classified as major logged with the regulator notification assessment and outcome

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when each change has an isolated capital impact and a major or minor classification

steps.title: Identify portfolio changes affecting the model segmentation
sop: List new, discontinued and materially changed lines of business for the period
Compare the list against the current model segmentation
Note each segmentation change required
Done when every portfolio change is mapped to a segmentation action
verify: Check the in-force line list against the model segment list
Pass when no in-force line is missing a model segment

steps.title: Reflect the revised reinsurance structure in the ceded module
sop: Take the current in-force treaty structure from the reinsurance records
Update retentions, limits and reinstatements in the ceded module of the platform
Confirm the ceded module reproduces a known treaty outcome
Done when the ceded module reflects the in-force programme
verify: Test one treaty through the module against its contract terms
Pass when modelled cessions match the contract terms

steps.title: Update the asset portfolio mapping in the market risk module
sop: Take the current asset allocation from the investment records
Remap reallocated holdings to the market risk module categories
Confirm no holding is left unmapped
Done when the market risk mapping reflects the current allocation
verify: Reconcile mapped market value to the total portfolio market value
Pass when mapped value equals the portfolio total

steps.title: Quantify the isolated capital impact of each change
sop: Run the model before and after each change with all else held constant
Record the capital requirement difference attributable to that change alone
Document the isolated impact in the change record
Done when each change carries an isolated before and after impact
verify: Check the sum of isolated impacts against the combined run difference
Pass when the isolated impacts explain the combined movement

steps.title: Classify each change against the model change policy
sop: Compare each isolated impact against the major change thresholds
Classify the change as major or minor and record the reasoning
Assess whether regulator notification is required for major changes
Done when every change is classified with the notification assessment
verify: Re-test one borderline change against the policy threshold
Pass when the classification follows the stated threshold

steps.title: Approve and version the change in the model governance repository
sop: Attach the impact analysis and classification to the change request
Obtain the approval required by the change policy for that classification
Version the updated model release in the repository
Done when the approved change is versioned in the repository
verify: Check the production version only contains approved change records
Pass when no unapproved change is present in the production version

generic.Defined scope/population: Modelled capital outputs by risk module for the reported run compared against internal and external benchmarks

steps.title: Compare modelled capital to the standard formula equivalent
sop: Compute the regulatory standard formula equivalent by risk module in Excel
Place modelled and standard formula values side by side
Compute the difference per module in currency and percentage
Done when every module has a standard formula comparison
verify: Check the module mapping between the two bases is complete
Pass when every modelled module maps to a formula component

steps.title: Benchmark against peer and rating agency capital measures
sop: Collect published peer capital ratios and rating agency capital measures
Normalise for size and business mix before comparing
Record where the company sits materially outside the peer range
Done when peer and agency benchmarks are compared and recorded
verify: Check the peer selection basis is documented
Pass when every benchmark carries a stated source and basis

steps.title: Independently recalculate one material risk module
sop: Select a material module and rebuild its capital with a simplified closed-form approach
Compare the independent result against the platform output
Explain any difference beyond the expected approximation error
Done when an independent recalculation exists for a material module
verify: Check the independent method does not reuse the platform calculation
Pass when the recalculation is genuinely independent and documented

steps.title: Run sensitivity tests on key assumptions

Compare the response against the expected behaviour
Done when every key assumption has a recorded sensitivity result
verify: Check each result moves in the expected direction
Pass when no sensitivity moves counter to expectation without explanation

steps.title: Log validation findings with severity and owner
sop: Raise a finding for each unexplained difference or failed expectation
Assign severity, owner and remediation date to each finding
Link every finding to the evidence that raised it
Done when all findings are logged with severity and owner
verify: Check each finding links to supporting evidence
Pass when no finding lacks evidence or an owner

steps.title: Issue the validation report for Chief Actuary review
sop: Review the comparisons, recalculation and findings for completeness
Challenge any explanation that is not supported by evidence
Sign and version the validation report in the model governance repository
Done when the signed validation report is versioned in the repository
verify: Check the report covers every material module and all open findings
Pass when no material module or open finding is omitted
